title: Callvale after: six ECS services on Fargate
claim: The load balancer routes by path to six Fargate services that each deploy and scale on their own, with images from Amazon ECR.
alt: After: the Application Load Balancer sends requests by path to six ECS services on Fargate in three Availability Zones: dashboard, upload, search, accounts, billing and admin. Each service pulls its image from Amazon ECR. Conversion workers stay on EC2.
notes: Brief 19 story pair, after; 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Decision). Title, claim, alt from brief.json; no steps. Same cells as containers-before (users A1, load balancer A2:B2, compute row 3, workers A4); Amazon ECR is new in B4. Each box lists three of the six services (twelve labelled arrows would not fit). The three zones are in the alt only: a longer group label runs into the arrows. The PrivateLink Network Load Balancer and Amazon Inspector are left out. No AWS number.
